401.heading: You are not authorized
401.description: You are missing the required rights to be able to access this page.

403.heading: Access denied
403.description: You do not have permission to view this page.

404.heading: Oops. This Page Not Found.
404.description: The page you are looking for is not available.

419.heading: Page expired
419.description: Your session has expired. Please return home and try again.

429.heading: Too many requests
429.description: You have sent too many requests in a short period of time. Please try again later.

500.heading: Internal Server Error
500.description: The server has been deserted for a while. Please be patient or try again later.

503.heading: Service unavailable
503.description: This service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
